cards.title: UPD execution document type is selected at creation

required_conditions: the execution step is being created

cards.allowed_action: Use the document type selected for the execution step; create a new execution if the type is wrong.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not treat invoice, UPD status 1, and UPD status 2 as interchangeable.
cards.handoff_condition: No support contact is established by this fragment.

cards.title: Generated UPD is sent after refresh and signing
cards.allowed_action: Refresh the page, select the generated XML, sign it with the electronic signature, and send it.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Generation alone does not prove that the document was signed or sent.
cards.handoff_condition: No support contact is established by this fragment.

cards.title: Successful UPD send reaches supplier-signed status
cards.allowed_action: After a successful send and refresh, wait for the customer signature.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Supplier-signed status is not customer acceptance or case resolution.
cards.handoff_condition: No support contact is established by this fragment.

cards.title: Failed UPD send returns the document to draft
cards.allowed_action: Review the displayed errors, fix blocking fields, and retry from the draft.
cards.forbidden_generalization: A send error does not mean the document was accepted or lost.
cards.handoff_condition: Contact support only when the source or a separate support rule requires it.

cards.title: No available action means wait for EIS confirmation
cards.allowed_action: Wait for the EIS confirmation when the source describes no available action.
cards.forbidden_generalization: An empty action list must not be interpreted as a generic error or as a completed document.
cards.handoff_condition: Support contact is supported only by the separate more-than-one-hour condition below.

cards.title: UPD status unchanged for more than one hour
cards.allowed_action: If the status has not updated for more than one hour, contact СТП ПП as the manual instructs.
cards.forbidden_generalization: One hour is a source-specific escalation condition, not a universal support SLA.
cards.handoff_condition: The source explicitly instructs contacting СТП ПП after the duration threshold.

cards.title: RDIK_0060 amount exceeds contract item

required_conditions: acceptance or corrective document is being formed

cards.allowed_action: Check the item amount against the amount recorded in the contract.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not apply this remedy to another RDIK code or to a total-stage error.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this code.

cards.title: RDIK_0059 total exceeds contract stage

required_conditions: acceptance or corrective document is being formed

cards.allowed_action: Check the total across acceptance documents and corrective documents against the contract stage amount.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not substitute an item-level rule or assume every amount error is RDIK_0059.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this code.

cards.title: RDIK_8169_3 quantity exceeds contract
cards.allowed_action: Correct the quantity or volume so it does not exceed the contract data.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not use this card for a price or amount error without the exact code.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this code.

cards.title: RDIK_ИК_1043 existing correction for source UPD

required_conditions: a correction for the source UPD already exists

cards.allowed_action: Check whether the source document is already corrected and use the source-described EIS or draft path.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not infer that every correction error means a duplicate correction.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this code.

cards.title: RDIK_ИК_1004 duplicate correction number
cards.allowed_action: Check the stage and existing documents before creating a correction with the same number.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not apply the alternative-stage guidance without the exact error context.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this code.

cards.title: Corrective UPD draft handling

required_conditions: a corrective document is being edited

cards.allowed_action: Follow the manual's distinction between an existing EIS draft and a draft already deleted in EIS.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not require deleting every EIS draft before editing a corrective document.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: MCD can be added from user or company profile

required_conditions: an XML MCD file is available

cards.allowed_action: Use the user profile path for the user’s own MCD or the company profile path for an administrator adding it to an employee.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not claim that a regular user may add an MCD to another employee’s profile.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: MCD upload requires the XML file action
cards.allowed_action: Choose the XML file in “Загрузить МЧД из файла” and press “Добавить”.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not describe a non-XML attachment or an unrelated profile upload as an MCD upload.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: Used MCD cannot be deleted

required_conditions: the MCD has already been used

cards.allowed_action: Keep an MCD that has been used; the manual permits deletion only when it has never been used.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not present the Delete action as available for every MCD.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: MCD permissions are role-scoped and listed by the source

required_conditions: adding an MCD to an employee

cards.allowed_action: Use the company profile administrator path and consult the source-linked ESNSI classifier for the permission list.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not invent permission names or grant them to a role not named by the source.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: YML import starts from generated nomenclature
cards.allowed_action: Generate a YML file from the supplier nomenclature or accounting system and send it through the import form.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not require manual characteristic IDs when the source says the developer step is no longer required.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: YML values use Portal reference catalogs
cards.allowed_action: Use the downloadable Portal catalogs from Offers → YML price-list import and preserve the documented category/parent relationship.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not substitute historical support data for the normative Portal catalogs or flatten a documented parent category relationship.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: Model is required for service/work STE entries

required_conditions: STE category is service or work

cards.allowed_action: Fill the Model field when the STE belongs to the service/work category described by the source.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not apply this mandatory-field statement to categories for which the source marks the field optional.
cards.handoff_condition: No source-backed support escalation is stated for this branch.

cards.title: STE/catalog import exposes explicit processing states
cards.allowed_action: Distinguish queued, processing, processing error, completed, completed with errors, cancelled, input-data error, and data-check states as documented.
cards.forbidden_generalization: Do not report queued or processing as completed, and do not hide completed-with-errors.
cards.handoff_condition: The fragment describes processing states but does not define a support handoff for each state.
